## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant browser/end-to-end checks

## Quality review

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal learner data added
- [ ] Accessibility impact reviewed
- [ ] Offline/local-storage behavior reviewed if affected
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed
- [ ] `what_changed.md` updated for milestone-level work

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for visible UI changes when useful.
